passages.text: Now the LORD said to Samuel, “How long are you going to mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and go. I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem, for I have selected from his sons a king for Myself.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Samuel.
The LORD asked Samuel a question.
The LORD said, “How long will you mourn for Saul?”
The LORD had rejected Saul as king over Israel.
The LORD commanded Samuel to act.
The LORD said, “Fill your horn with oil.”
The LORD said, “Go.”
The LORD said, “I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem.”
The LORD had chosen a king for Himself from Jesse’s sons.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל עַד־ מָתַי֙ אַתָּה֙ מִתְאַבֵּ֣ל אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל וַאֲנִ֣י מְאַסְתִּ֔יו מִמְּלֹ֖ךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מַלֵּ֨א קַרְנְךָ֜ שֶׁ֗מֶן וְלֵ֤ךְ אֶֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֙ אֶל־ יִשַׁ֣י בֵּֽית־ הַלַּחְמִ֔י כִּֽי־ רָאִ֧יתִי בְּבָנָ֛יו לִ֖י מֶֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: “How can I go?” Samuel asked. “Saul will hear of it and kill me!” The LORD answered, “Take a heifer with you and say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.’
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of God.
God told Samuel to go to Jesse in Bethlehem.
God wanted Samuel to anoint a new king from Jesse’s sons.
Saul was the current king of Israel.
Samuel said, “How can I go?”
Samuel feared Saul.
Samuel said, “Saul will hear about it and kill me.”
The LORD answered Samuel.
The LORD said, “Take a young cow with you.”
The LORD said, “Say, ‘I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֵ֣יךְ אֵלֵ֔ךְ וְשָׁמַ֥ע שָׁא֖וּל וַהֲרָגָ֑נִיס וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה עֶגְלַ֤ת בָּקָר֙ תִּקַּ֣ח בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ לִזְבֹּ֥חַ לַֽיהוָ֖ה בָּֽאתִי׃

passages.text: Then invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what you are to do. You are to anoint for Me the one I indicate.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Samuel.
God told Samuel to invite Jesse to the sacrifice.
God said He would show Samuel what to do next.
God commanded Samuel to anoint the person God would point out.
God chose this person to be king.
passages.original: וְקָרָ֥אתָ לְיִשַׁ֖י בַּזָּ֑בַח וְאָֽנֹכִ֗י אוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶֽׁר־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֣ לִ֔י אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ אֹמַ֖ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: So Samuel did what the LORD had said and went to Bethlehem. When the elders of the town met him, they trembled and asked, “Do you come in peace?”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of the LORD.
The LORD spoke to Samuel and gave him instructions.
Samuel obeyed the LORD.
Samuel went to Bethlehem.
The elders of Bethlehem were the leaders of the town.
The elders saw Samuel arrive.
The elders trembled when they met Samuel.
The elders asked Samuel, “Do you come in peace?”
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֣ית לָ֑חֶם וַיֶּחֶרְד֞וּ זִקְנֵ֤י הָעִיר֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֹ֥ם בּוֹאֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: “In peace,” he replied. “I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Consecrate yourselves and come with me to the sacrifice.” Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of the LORD.
Samuel answered the elders of Bethlehem.
Samuel said, “I come in peace.”
Samuel said, “I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.”
Samuel told the people, “Consecrate yourselves.”
Samuel told them, “Come with me to the sacrifice.”
Samuel consecrated Jesse.
Samuel consecrated Jesse’s sons.
Samuel invited Jesse and his sons to the sacrifice.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ שָׁל֗וֹם לִזְבֹּ֤חַ לַֽיהוָה֙ בָּ֔אתִי הִֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וּבָאתֶ֥ם אִתִּ֖י בַּזָּ֑בַח וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֶת־ יִשַׁי֙ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֔יו וַיִּקְרָ֥א לָהֶ֖ם לַזָּֽבַח׃

passages.text: When they arrived, Samuel saw Eliab and said, “Surely here before the LORD is His anointed.”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of the LORD.
Samuel came to Bethlehem to offer a sacrifice to the LORD.
Jesse and his sons arrived with Samuel.
Samuel saw Eliab, Jesse’s son.
Samuel said, “Surely the LORD’s anointed stands here before Him.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֔ם וַיַּ֖רְא אֶת־ אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אַ֛ךְ נֶ֥גֶד יְהוָ֖ה מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃

passages.text: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Samuel.
The LORD said, “Do not look at his appearance.
Do not look at his height.
I have rejected him.
I do not see as man sees.
Man looks at the outward appearance.
I, the LORD, look at the heart.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אַל־ תַּבֵּ֧ט אֶל־ מַרְאֵ֛הוּ וְאֶל־ גְּבֹ֥הַּ קוֹמָת֖וֹ כִּ֣י מְאַסְתִּ֑יהוּ כִּ֣י׀ לֹ֗א אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִרְאֶה֙ הָאָדָ֔ם כִּ֤י הָֽאָדָם֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה לַעֵינַ֔יִם וַיהוָ֖ה יִרְאֶ֥ה לַלֵּבָֽב׃

passages.text: Then Jesse called Abinadab and presented him to Samuel, who said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”
passages.sermon:
Jesse was the father of several sons.
Jesse called his son Abinadab.
Jesse brought Abinadab to Samuel.
Samuel was a prophet of the LORD.
Samuel saw Abinadab.
Samuel said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א יִשַׁי֙ אֶל־ אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֖הוּ לִפְנֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם־ בָּזֶ֖ה לֹֽא־ בָחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Next Jesse presented Shammah, but Samuel said, “The LORD has not chosen this one either.”
passages.sermon:
Jesse was the father of several sons.
Jesse brought his son Shammah to Samuel.
Samuel was a prophet of the LORD.
Samuel looked at Shammah.
Samuel said, “The LORD has not chosen this one.”
passages.original: וַיַּעֲבֵ֥ר יִשַׁ֖י שַׁמָּ֑ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר גַּם־ בָּזֶ֖ה לֹא־ בָחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Thus Jesse made seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel told him, “The LORD has not chosen any of these.”
passages.sermon:
Jesse was the father of several sons.
Jesse brought seven of his sons to Samuel.
Samuel was a prophet of the LORD.
Samuel watched as each son passed before him.
Samuel spoke to Jesse.
Samuel said, “The LORD has not chosen any of these.”
passages.original: וַיַּעֲבֵ֥ר יִשַׁ֛י שִׁבְעַ֥ת בָּנָ֖יו לִפְנֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ יִשַׁ֔י לֹא־ בָחַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בָּאֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: And Samuel asked him, “Are these all the sons you have?” “There is still the youngest,” Jesse replied, “but he is tending the sheep.” “Send for him,” Samuel replied. “For we will not sit down to eat until he arrives.”
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of the LORD.
Jesse was the father of several sons.
Samuel spoke to Jesse.
Samuel asked, “Are these all your sons?”
Jesse answered Samuel.
Jesse said, “There is still the youngest son.”
Jesse said, “He is tending the sheep.”
Samuel spoke to Jesse again.
Samuel said, “Send for him.”
Samuel said, “Bring him here.”
Samuel said, “We will not sit down to eat until he arrives.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל אֶל־ יִשַׁי֮ הֲתַ֣מּוּ הַנְּעָרִים֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר ע֚וֹד שָׁאַ֣ר הַקָּטָ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֥ה רֹעֶ֖ה בַּצֹּ֑אן וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל אֶל־ יִשַׁי֙ שִׁלְחָ֣ה וְקָחֶ֔נּוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־ נָסֹ֖ב עַד־ בֹּא֥וֹ פֹֽה׃

passages.text: So Jesse sent for his youngest son and brought him in. He was ruddy, with beautiful eyes and a handsome appearance. And the LORD said, “Rise and anoint him, for he is the one.”
passages.sermon:
Jesse sent for his youngest son.
Jesse brought his youngest son in.
The youngest son was ruddy.
He had beautiful eyes.
He had a handsome appearance.
The LORD spoke.
The LORD said, "Rise and anoint him."
The LORD said, "He is the one."
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח וַיְבִיאֵ֙הוּ֙ וְה֣וּא אַדְמוֹנִ֔י עִם־ יְפֵ֥ה עֵינַ֖יִם וְט֣וֹב רֹ֑אִי פ וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה ק֥וּם מְשָׁחֵ֖הוּ כִּֽי־ זֶ֥ה הֽוּא׃

passages.text: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward. Then Samuel set out and went to Ramah.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet of God.
Samuel took a horn filled with oil.
Samuel anointed David with the oil.
David’s brothers were present.
The Spirit of the LORD came powerfully upon David.
This happened from that day onward.
Samuel got up.
Samuel went to Ramah.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל אֶת־ קֶ֣רֶן הַשֶּׁ֗מֶן וַיִּמְשַׁ֣ח אֹתוֹ֮ בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֶחָיו֒ וַתִּצְלַ֤ח רֽוּחַ־ יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד מֵהַיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא וָמָ֑עְלָה וַיָּ֣קָם שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ הָרָמָֽתָה׃ס

passages.text: After the Spirit of the LORD had departed from Saul, a spirit of distress from the LORD began to torment him.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
The Spirit of the LORD left Saul.
A spirit of distress came from the LORD.
This spirit began to torment Saul.
passages.original: וְר֧וּחַ יְהוָ֛ה סָ֖רָה מֵעִ֣ם שָׁא֑וּל וּבִֽעֲתַ֥תּוּ רֽוּחַ־ רָעָ֖ה מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Saul’s servants said to him, “Surely a spirit of distress from God is tormenting you.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul’s servants spoke to him.
They said, “A spirit from God is troubling you.
This spirit brings distress.
It is tormenting you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ עַבְדֵֽי־ שָׁא֖וּל אֵלָ֑יו הִנֵּה־ נָ֧א רֽוּחַ־ אֱלֹהִ֛ים רָעָ֖ה מְבַעִתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Let our lord command your servants here to seek out someone who can skillfully play the harp. Whenever the spirit of distress from God is upon you, he is to play it, and you will be well.”
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
The Spirit of the LORD had left Saul.
A spirit of distress from God began to torment Saul.
Saul’s servants spoke to him.
They said, “Let our lord command your servants who stand before you.
Let us look for a man who knows how to play the harp well.
When the spirit of distress from God comes upon you, he will play the harp with his hand.
Then you will feel better.”
passages.original: יֹאמַר־ נָ֤א אֲדֹנֵ֙נוּ֙ עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ יְבַקְשׁ֕וּ אִ֕ישׁ יֹדֵ֖עַ מְנַגֵּ֣ן בַּכִּנּ֑וֹר וְהָיָ֗ה בִּֽהְי֨וֹת עָלֶ֤יךָ רֽוּחַ־ אֱלֹהִים֙ רָעָ֔ה וְנִגֵּ֥ן בְּיָד֖וֹ וְט֥וֹב לָֽךְ׃פ

passages.text: And Saul commanded his servants, “Find me someone who plays well, and bring him to me.”
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul spoke to his servants.
Saul gave them a command.
He said, “Look for a man who plays music well.”
He said, “Bring him to me.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר שָׁא֖וּל אֶל־ עֲבָדָ֑יו רְאוּ־ נָ֣א לִ֗י אִ֚ישׁ מֵיטִ֣יב לְנַגֵּ֔ן וַהֲבִיאוֹתֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: One of the servants answered, “I have seen a son of Jesse of Bethlehem who knows how to play the harp. He is a mighty man of valor, a warrior, eloquent and handsome, and the LORD is with him.”
passages.sermon:
One of Saul’s servants spoke.
He said, “I have seen a son of Jesse from Bethlehem.
This son knows how to play the harp.
He is a mighty man of valor.
He is a warrior.
He speaks wisely.
He is handsome.
The LORD is with him.”
passages.original: וַיַּעַן֩ אֶחָ֨ד מֵהַנְּעָרִ֜ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֨ה רָאִ֜יתִי בֵּ֣ן לְיִשַׁי֮ בֵּ֣ית הַלַּחְמִי֒ יֹדֵ֣עַ נַ֠גֵּן וְגִבּ֨וֹר חַ֜יִל וְאִ֧ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֛ה וּנְב֥וֹן דָּבָ֖ר וְאִ֣ישׁ תֹּ֑אַר וַיהוָ֖ה עִמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, “Send me your son David, who is with the sheep.”
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Saul sent messengers to Jesse.
Jesse was David’s father.
Saul gave a command to Jesse.
Saul said, “Send me your son David.”
David was with the sheep.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח שָׁא֛וּל מַלְאָכִ֖ים אֶל־ יִשָׁ֑י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁלְחָ֥ה אֵלַ֛י אֶת־ דָּוִ֥ד בִּנְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּצֹּֽאן׃

passages.text: And Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine, and one young goat, and sent them to Saul with his son David.
passages.sermon:
Jesse was David’s father.
Jesse took a donkey.
Jesse put bread on the donkey.
Jesse took a skin filled with wine.
Jesse took one young goat.
Jesse gave these things to his son David.
Jesse sent David to Saul.
David brought the bread, wine, and goat to Saul.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח יִשַׁ֜י חֲמ֥וֹר לֶ֙חֶם֙ וְנֹ֣אד יַ֔יִן וּגְדִ֥י עִזִּ֖ים אֶחָ֑ד וַיִּשְׁלַ֛ח בְּיַד־ דָּוִ֥ד בְּנ֖וֹ אֶל־ שָׁאֽוּל׃

passages.text: When David came to Saul and entered his service, Saul admired him greatly, and David became his armor-bearer.
passages.sermon:
David came to Saul.
David stood before Saul.
Saul admired David very much.
David became Saul’s armor-bearer.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א דָוִד֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד לְפָנָ֑יו וַיֶּאֱהָבֵ֣הֽוּ מְאֹ֔ד וַֽיְהִי־ ל֖וֹ נֹשֵׂ֥א כֵלִֽים׃

passages.text: Then Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, “Let David remain in my service, for I am pleased with him.”
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Jesse was David’s father.
David was Jesse’s son.
David served Saul.
Saul sent a message to Jesse.
Saul said, “Let David stay with me.”
Saul said, “I am pleased with David.”
Saul wanted David to remain in his service.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח שָׁא֔וּל אֶל־ יִשַׁ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר יַעֲמָד־ נָ֤א דָוִד֙ לְפָנַ֔י כִּֽי־ מָ֥צָא חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינָֽי׃

passages.text: And whenever the spirit from God came upon Saul, David would pick up his harp and play, and Saul would become well, and the spirit of distress would depart from him.
passages.sermon:
Saul was the king of Israel.
Sometimes a spirit from God came upon Saul.
When this happened, Saul felt troubled.
David was a young man who served Saul.
David would take his harp in his hand.
David would play music on the harp.
When David played, Saul felt relief.
Saul became well.
The spirit of distress left Saul.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בִּֽהְי֤וֹת רֽוּחַ־ אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל וְלָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ הַכִּנּ֖וֹר וְנִגֵּ֣ן בְּיָד֑וֹ וְרָוַ֤ח לְשָׁאוּל֙ וְט֣וֹב ל֔וֹ וְסָ֥רָה מֵעָלָ֖יו ר֥וּחַ הָרָעָֽה׃פ
